chapter.title: Allowances and transfers
chapter.subtitle: What an approval really records
chapter.sub: Chapter two: allowances and transfers. Let's look at the records this whole study is built on.
chapter.tts: Chapter two. Allowances and transfers. Let's look at the records this whole study is built on.

lines.sub: We begin with DeFi, short for decentralized finance.
lines.tts: We begin with DeFi, short for decentralized finance.

lines.sub: In place of a clerk at a bank counter, programs exchange money, hold it and put it to work, and lend it.
lines.tts: In place of a clerk at a bank counter, programs exchange money, hold it and put it to work, and lend it.

lines.sub: The routers, vaults and lending pools in this video are all programs of this kind.
lines.tts: The routers, vaults and lending pools in this video are all programs of this kind.

lines.sub: On the left, a router swaps my tokens for other tokens.
lines.tts: On the left, a router swaps my tokens for other tokens.

lines.sub: In the middle, a vault puts the tokens I deposit to work.
lines.tts: In the middle, a vault puts the tokens I deposit to work.

lines.sub: And on the right, in a lending pool, people lend and borrow.
lines.tts: And on the right, in a lending pool, people lend and borrow.

lines.sub: Such a program is called a smart contract.
lines.tts: Such a program is called a smart contract.

card.title: Smart contract
card.body: A program on the blockchain that runs by itself under fixed rules

lines.sub: It runs by itself on the blockchain, following fixed rules.
lines.tts: It runs by itself on the blockchain, following fixed rules.

lines.sub: Before these contracts can move a user's tokens, they first need the user's permission, an allowance.
lines.tts: Before these contracts can move a user's tokens, they first need the user's permission, an allowance.

lines.sub: That allowance is what the next slide is about.
lines.tts: That allowance is what the next slide is about.

lines.sub: Let me put two kinds of record side by side.
lines.tts: Let me put two kinds of record side by side.

lines.sub: On the left, in blue, is a transfer.
lines.tts: On the left, in blue, is a transfer.

lines.sub: On the right, in amber, is an allowance.
lines.tts: On the right, in amber, is an allowance.

lines.sub: A transfer means tokens actually move.
lines.tts: A transfer means tokens actually move.

lines.sub: Follow the blue arrow: the coins flow from the sender to the recipient.
lines.tts: Follow the blue arrow. The coins flow from the sender to the recipient.

lines.sub: An allowance is different.
lines.tts: An allowance is different.

lines.sub: The token owner promises a contract: “you may take up to this much of my tokens.”
lines.tts: The token owner promises a contract, you may take up to this much of my tokens.

lines.sub: The owner grants it with the approve function of the ERC-20 token standard.
lines.tts: The owner grants it with the approve function of the E R C twenty token standard.

lines.sub: Or with permit, the signature-based approval of its extension, EIP-2612.
lines.tts: Or with permit, the signature-based approval of its extension, E I P twenty-six twelve.

lines.sub: Either way, the same record is left behind: an Approval event.
lines.tts: Either way, the same record is left behind, an Approval event.

lines.sub: So this amber arrow does not flow. It just stays in place.
lines.tts: So this amber arrow does not flow. It just stays in place.

lines.sub: The 1,000 USDC on it is only an example for the explanation.
lines.tts: The one thousand U S D C on it is only an example for the explanation.

lines.sub: Later, the spender contract can call transferFrom to actually move the owner's tokens, up to the approved amount.
lines.tts: Later, the spender contract can call transfer from to actually move the owner's tokens, up to the approved amount.

lines.sub: The value this study uses is the amount written in the latest approval record.
lines.tts: The value this study uses is the amount written in the latest approval record.

lines.sub: Now the owner approves the same contract again, this time up to 500 USDC.
lines.tts: Now the owner approves the same contract again, this time up to five hundred U S D C.

lines.sub: For the same owner, contract and token, the most recent approval overwrites the earlier one.
lines.tts: For the same owner, contract and token, the most recent approval overwrites the earlier one.

lines.sub: So for each owner, spender and token, this study uses only the latest allowance as an edge, an arrow in the graph.
lines.tts: So for each owner, spender and token, this study uses only the latest allowance as an edge, an arrow in the graph.

lines.sub: Approving an amount of 0 revokes the allowance.
lines.tts: Approving an amount of zero revokes the allowance.

lines.sub: A revoked allowance leaves no edge, so the arrow is gone.
lines.tts: A revoked allowance leaves no edge, so the arrow is gone.

lines.sub: An approval entrusts my tokens to a contract.
lines.tts: An approval entrusts my tokens to a contract.

lines.sub: So it can be read as trust in the contract that receives it, an edge of endorsement.
lines.tts: So it can be read as trust in the contract that receives it, an edge of endorsement.

lines.sub: It is like the way a link on the web can be read as a citation.
lines.tts: It is like the way a link on the web can be read as a citation.

lines.sub: The box on the right sums up this first reading: an allowance edge as evidence of trust.
lines.tts: The box on the right sums up this first reading, an allowance edge as evidence of trust.

lines.sub: Now many owners approve one contract.
lines.tts: Now many owners approve one contract.

lines.sub: With all these arrows coming in, it looks as if it has received many endorsements.
lines.tts: With all these arrows coming in, it looks as if it has received many endorsements.

lines.sub: But we have to be careful.
lines.tts: But we have to be careful.

lines.sub: Next to the first contract, in the middle of the screen, is a phishing contract.
lines.tts: Next to the first contract, in the middle of the screen, is a phishing contract.

lines.sub: When a phishing site tricks someone into approving, the record left behind is exactly the same as an honest one.
lines.tts: When a phishing site tricks someone into approving, the record left behind is exactly the same as an honest one.

lines.sub: From the arrows alone, the two boxes cannot be told apart.
lines.tts: From the arrows alone, the two boxes cannot be told apart.

lines.sub: People also approve simply because it is convenient.
lines.tts: People also approve simply because it is convenient.

lines.sub: In this study's data, too, 45.8% of the latest allowances were unlimited approvals.
lines.tts: In this study's data, too, forty-five point eight percent of the latest allowances were unlimited approvals.

lines.sub: That is out of 12.59 million non-zero latest allowances at the end of the observation window.
lines.tts: That is out of twelve point five nine million non-zero latest allowances at the end of the observation window.

lines.sub: Unlimited means no cap on the amount.
lines.tts: Unlimited means no cap on the amount.

lines.sub: So this thesis treats an allowance not as firm evidence of trust, but as a signal that “can be read” as an endorsement.
lines.tts: So this thesis treats an allowance not as firm evidence of trust, but as a signal that can be read as an endorsement.

lines.sub: There is one thing I must point out here. The graph mixes two kinds of address.
lines.tts: There is one thing I must point out here. The graph mixes two kinds of address.

lines.sub: A circle is an externally owned account, an EOA, which a person controls with a private key.
lines.tts: A circle is an externally owned account, an E O A, which a person controls with a private key.

card.title: EOA
card.body: An ordinary address that a person controls with a private key

lines.sub: And a square is a smart contract.
lines.tts: And a square is a smart contract.

lines.sub: Every address this study scored and evaluated is a smart contract.
lines.tts: Every address this study scored and evaluated is a smart contract.

lines.sub: An EOA appears in the graph only as an owner, a sender or a recipient, and it receives no score.
lines.tts: An E O A appears in the graph only as an owner, a sender or a recipient, and it receives no score.

lines.sub: Score badges go only on the squares, that is, on contracts.
lines.tts: Score badges go only on the squares, that is, on contracts.

lines.sub: The circles get only the label “endpoint”.
lines.tts: The circles get only the label endpoint.

lines.sub: We decided whether an address is a contract by checking whether program code sits at that address.
lines.tts: We decided whether an address is a contract by checking whether program code sits at that address.

lines.sub: For the cohort candidates, which the next chapter introduces, we looked for code at one fixed block.
lines.tts: For the cohort candidates, which the next chapter introduces, we looked for code at one fixed block.

lines.sub: For the remaining holdout spenders and GMX accounts, which come up later in the video, we looked at later blocks within three hours.
lines.tts: For the remaining holdout spenders and G M X accounts, which come up later in the video, we looked at later blocks within three hours.

lines.sub: Under EIP-7702, an ordinary account can carry a short pointer to a contract's code, called a delegation designator.
lines.tts: Under E I P seventy-seven oh two, an ordinary account can carry a short pointer to a contract's code, called a delegation designator.

lines.sub: An address whose code was only such a pointer was counted as an EOA.
lines.tts: An address whose code was only such a pointer was counted as an E O A.

lines.sub: So where does all of this happen?
lines.tts: So where does all of this happen?

lines.sub: The study takes place on Arbitrum One.
lines.tts: The study takes place on Arbitrum One.

lines.sub: Arbitrum One is a rollup that runs on top of Ethereum.
lines.tts: Arbitrum One is a rollup that runs on top of Ethereum.

lines.sub: On the right, Arbitrum One is the upper plate, sitting on Ethereum below.
lines.tts: On the right, Arbitrum One is the upper plate, sitting on Ethereum below.

lines.sub: Because it bundles transactions and posts them to Ethereum together, its fees are low, and people transact often.
lines.tts: Because it bundles transactions and posts them to Ethereum together, its fees are low, and people transact often.

lines.sub: Its chain ID is 42161.
lines.tts: Its chain ID is four two one six one.

lines.sub: Every approval and transfer record here can be read by anyone in the public data of Google BigQuery.
lines.tts: Every approval and transfer record here can be read by anyone in the public data of Google Big Query.

lines.sub: Watch the dots dropping into the database: the amber dots are approval records, and the sky-blue dots are transfer records.
lines.tts: Watch the dots dropping into the database. The amber dots are approval records, and the sky-blue dots are transfer records.

lines.sub: There is also a reason for looking at only one chain.
lines.tts: There is also a reason for looking at only one chain.

lines.sub: If one person holds the same address on several chains, it shows up as separate nodes, separate points in the graph.
lines.tts: If one person holds the same address on several chains, it shows up as separate nodes, separate points in the graph.

lines.sub: So comparing within one chain is cleaner.
lines.tts: So comparing within one chain is cleaner.

lines.sub: I have now laid that plate on its side. This line will be our time axis.
lines.tts: I have now laid that plate on its side. This line will be our time axis.
